title: observability.yml
description: Observability settings for one service: a shared resource, one section per signal and the GenAI section. A thin wrapper that the loader turns into standard OTEL_* settings; see references/config.md.

version.description: File format version. A literal 1, never interpolated.

resource.description: Who is sending. Shared by every signal.

name.description: service.name. Stable across releases and replicas.

namespace.description: service.namespace: the application group the deployment is part of (its partOf name). Empty means not set.

version.description: service.version from the build. Never a default.

attributes.description: The pod identity from the downward API: k8s.namespace.name, k8s.pod.name, k8s.pod.uid and k8s.node.name; plus k8s.cluster.name where several clusters send to one backend, which the downward API doesn't provide, so the chart sets it per cluster. The standard adds nothing else. Values that resolve empty are dropped. Identity keys have their own fields.

tracing.description: Traces: OTLP export, sampling and path exclusions.

exclude_paths.description: Request paths whose successful responses are not traced: the probes and the API docs paths.

trace_failed_probes.description: Keep traces of failed requests to excluded paths. Failed probes are always logged and counted.

metrics.description: Metrics: the ops metrics on /metrics for Prometheus to scrape; OTLP push of app metrics is off by default.

enabled.description: Turn metrics on or off as a whole: the /metrics server and OTLP push.

prometheus.description: Pull: the ops metrics, produced by the stack's Prometheus client library, on their own port for Prometheus or the collector to scrape.

host.description: Listen address of the /metrics server. 0.0.0.0 so Prometheus or the collector can reach it.

port.description: Port of the /metrics server. Never the application port.

exclude_paths.description: Request paths whose successful responses are not measured: the probes, /metrics and the API docs paths. Failures count in app_health_probe_failures_total.

otlp.description: Push over OTLP: off by default. A team may switch it on for its own app metrics made with the OpenTelemetry API; the ops metrics stay on /metrics.

enabled.description: Push the team's app metrics over OTLP (OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER otlp).

temporality.description: OTLP push temporality (OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_TEMPORALITY_PREFERENCE): delta when sending directly to a backend that requires it; through a collector, keep cumulative and convert there. The Prometheus scrape is always cumulative.

logging.description: Application logs and the access log.

output.description: stdout (the collector ships it), otlp, or a list of both for a service sending directly to a backend without a log-shipping collector.

exporter.description: OTLP exporter used when the output includes otlp.

application.description: The service's own log records. Errors are reported from these.

enabled.description: Set up application logs (format, native trace ids, level, output).

level.description: Root log level; it controls volume. debug: every function step; info: requests, job runs, WebSocket lifecycle and milestones; warn: 4xx, slow steps, retries and rejected connections; error: one record per failure. Above error silences error reporting.

slow_threshold.description: A wrapped function slower than this writes a WARN step log, e.g. 2s or 500ms. Unset: no slow-step warnings.

access_log.description: One record per request at response end. Allow-lists only; bodies off by default and logs-only.

exclude_paths.description: Request paths whose successful responses are not logged: the probes and the API docs paths. Failures emit health.probe.failed.

headers.description: Request headers to log as http.request.header.<name>.

cookies.description: Cookie names to log as http.request.cookie.<name>. Never credential cookies.

headers.description: Response headers to log as http.response.header.<name>.

exporter.description: Profile destination: the collector's profile receiver or a backend.

protocol.description: Pyroscope protocol or OTLP profiles, whichever the destination ingests.

rum.description: Browser RUM and session replay. Configuration is served to the browser at runtime.

endpoint.description: Backend OTLP base URL the same-origin proxy forwards to (the browser posts to /telemetry/v1/<signal> on its own origin).

headers.description: Added server-side by the proxy; never sent to the browser.

app_identifier.description: Identifier of the browser application in the RUM backend.

enabled.description: Record sessions. Starts only with input masking in place.

host.description: Origin of the replay backend the proxy forwards to; the recorder appends /telemetry/session-replay/... itself.

headers.description: Headers the replay proxy adds, e.g. the replay backend's key, when rum.exporter goes to a collector that holds the OTLP key; defaults to rum.exporter.headers. Never sent to the browser.

genai.description: LLM and agent telemetry: the GenAI client metrics, the content policy and Langfuse as a second trace destination. Off by default; see references/signals/genai.md.

enabled.description: GenAI telemetry: the gen_ai_client_* metrics, the AI feature context and, when configured, Langfuse. Off keeps every content capture switch off.

content.description: Prompts, completions, tool arguments and results, retrieved documents and media. Recorded only on spans bound for Langfuse, never in logs, metrics or the ops backend.

capture.description: The most this environment allows: off; redacted (features with a redactor record redacted content); full (raw content, only where the data is synthetic). Production takes off or redacted.

sample_ratio.description: Share of traces that carry content, decided from the trace id.

max_chars.description: Characters per content attribute after redaction; a longer value is cut, keeping valid JSON and the newest turn.

media.description: Images, audio and files: reference (type, size and hash only) or upload (to Langfuse's media store, only with capture full).

enabled.description: The gen_ai_client_* metrics on /metrics, recorded at each model call.

langfuse.description: Langfuse as the LLM-observability destination: AI traces with content, and feedback and evaluator scores in the hybrid and sdk modes. Prompts, datasets and evaluators are the app's own Langfuse features; app code takes the module's client for them. See references/backends/langfuse.md.

mode.description: Who makes and sends the AI spans (references/signals/genai.md, Modes): hybrid (OpenTelemetry instrumentations and the module's helpers; the Langfuse SDK sends them and the scores), sdk (the Langfuse SDK makes the AI observations, Python and TypeScript only), otel (no Langfuse SDK for telemetry: the module's OTLP exporter or the collector sends them; no scores). App code is the same in every mode.

export.description: app: the app sends the AI spans (the Langfuse SDK's span processor in hybrid and sdk, the module's OTLP exporter in otel); collector: the collector's Langfuse branch sends them (hybrid and otel only).

scope.description: Spans sent to Langfuse: ai_context (AI spans plus the entry and function spans of an AI feature, never other client or producer spans) or ai_only (AI spans only). Every exported span is a billed observation.

base_url.description: Langfuse origin, e.g. https://cloud.langfuse.com or a self-hosted URL; the module adds the OTLP and API paths.

public_key.description: The project's public key, through ${file:...} or ${env:...}.

secret_key.description: The project's secret key, only through ${file:...} or ${env:...}; server-side only, never in a browser.

flush_interval.description: How often batched spans are sent.

scores.description: Feedback and evaluator scores, sent by the server with stable ids; hybrid and sdk only (the otel mode never calls Langfuse's API).

interpolated.description: A string holding a ${VAR}, ${env:VAR}, ${VAR:-default} or ${file:/path} reference, resolved once at start-up.

duration.description: A whole number with a unit: ms, s, m or h, e.g. 10s.

path.description: A URL path starting with /, without query or fragment.

excludePath.description: A request path to exclude, without query or fragment. Matches that exact path; an entry ending in /* matches every path below it, e.g. /api-docs/* (list /api-docs as well for the page itself).

pathList.description: Paths matched exactly, query string ignored, or a subtree with a trailing /*.

headers.description: Headers added to every request to the destination, e.g. backend auth. Secrets only through ${file:...} or ${env:...}.

headerName.description: Lowercase HTTP header name. Credentials, cookies and raw client-IP headers are never logged.

bodyField.description: A top-level JSON field name or a dot path into nested objects, e.g. order.total.

bodyCapture.description: Body capture into the access log only, never spans. Off by default.

fields.description: Selected JSON fields to log as-is. The normal case.

full.description: Last resort: log the masked body, cut at max_bytes. Bounded, temporary, explicit.

max_bytes.description: Bytes teed from the stream. A larger body is cut for full capture and not parsed for fields.

otlpExporter.description: OTLP exporter for one signal, written to the per-signal OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_{TRACES,METRICS,LOGS}_* settings.

endpoint.description: Collector or backend. gRPC: scheme://host:port. http/protobuf: base URL; /v1/<signal> is appended. Default port 4318 for http/protobuf.

insecure.description: Plaintext gRPC for an endpoint without a scheme. Never disables TLS on https://.

tls.description: Mounted PEM files for TLS: the CA that signs the endpoint's certificate and, for mTLS, the client certificate and key (OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_<SIGNAL>_CERTIFICATE, _CLIENT_CERTIFICATE, _CLIENT_KEY). Paths only, never inline PEM.

sampler.description: Trace sampler, written unchanged to OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER and OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG.

name.description: A standard sampler name or any sampler the SDK registers.

arg.description: Sampler argument as a string: a ratio from 0 to 1 for *traceidratio; endpoint=...,pollingIntervalMs=...,initialSamplingRate=... for *jaeger_remote.
